# Event Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EventType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of an event — a VALUE, never a [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) subclass. The set is open; a kind not among the seed individuals is a FRESH [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) individual carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label), not a new class. Pointed at by [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) (non-functional).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the event-kind axis — the open set of individuals (marriage, release, survey, …) that [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) draws from; mint a fresh individual when a needed kind is not seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting an event-kind SUBCLASS of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) — no overtyping); a new kind is always a fresh [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) individual, never a class, and never a [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) (that is the orthogonal who-did-what axis).

### How to use

- Add a new kind as a [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition); reference it from events via [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md), co-typing freely since the property is non-functional.

### Examples

- ex:eventTypeCoronation a [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "coronation"@en.
